headline: A 2001 executive order tells federal agencies to speed up actions on energy-related projects.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to move faster on energy-related projects. That likely means agencies should speed up their reviews, permits, or approvals for such projects. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, deadlines, and agencies involved are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that review or approve energy projects
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to handle energy-related projects more quickly.

who_it_affects.group: Companies building or running energy projects
who_it_affects.how: They may get faster federal decisions on their projects.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 18, 2001; the source does not state a separate effective date.
